purpose: Teach: 俊輔/ノブ/ひで/裕子/京子/千尋/貞/みゆき

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「俊輔くんは才能がある」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying that Shun's got real talent.
lines.style: Warm and conversational, as if sharing a small proud observation. Light pace. Eyes soft. The casual certainty of someone relaying something that pleased her to hear.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとノブおじさんに会ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I met Dad and Uncle Nobu today.
lines.style: Direct and matter-of-fact, the way a six-year-old reports something real that happened. Clear pronunciation. No embellishment. A small, genuine pride in having experienced something.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがご友人のひでさんと釣りに行かれるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad's going fishing with his friend Hide, it seems.
lines.style: Gentle voice settling into reflection. Slight pause before speaking, like she's picturing it. Even pace, warm but thoughtful. The tone of someone sharing news that gives her a moment to think.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと裕子おばさんに会ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I met Dad and Aunt Yuko today.
lines.style: Same directness as before, but with slightly more eagerness in the telling. Voice lifts just a touch. Still clear and unadorned, but wanting her to understand this was important.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「京子さんはお茶の先生」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying that Kyoko is a tea ceremony teacher—a fine person.
lines.style: Same warm, reflective register as line one. Gentle delivery of someone's admiration for another. Slight pause after 'teacher' before the second part, as if completing the thought. Composed but genuinely pleased.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと「千と千尋の神隠し」の映画観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched Spirited Away with Dad today.
lines.style: Open and bright. Voice rises slightly at the movie title—he knows it's special. Quick, unrushed delivery. The pure satisfaction of a child sharing something wonderful he experienced.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「貞節を大事にする方は素敵」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying that someone who values integrity is really admirable.
lines.style: Measured and thoughtful, with a quality of gentle philosophy. Slightly slower pace. Eyes forward, not quite at him—the tone of someone sharing something her husband said that she herself thinks matters.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんのお友達のみゆきさんに挨拶したよ
lines.en: Mom, I said hello to Dad's friend Miyuki today.
lines.style: Quieter than his previous lines, but carrying the same genuine pride. Voice is clear but smaller—this was a moment of doing something a little grown-up. Slight lift at the end, seeking her recognition.
